description: Sets the local-part word (before the @) each kind of email sends from on the app's own verified domain: account, support and/or news. These are also the Inbox's own labels — a reply arrives at <word>@<domain>, so changing one changes where that kind's replies land too. Send one, two or all three; the others are left as they are. Before go-live it acts at once; once live, the founder approves it in the browser (request_email_sender_look).
name: set_sender_words
title: Set the sender words
